title: Royal Blue Georgette Anarkali Suit Set with Handwork & Gota Lace Dupatta
color_custom: Royal blue with gold handwork & gota lace
description:
Made for the moment you walk in. This royal-blue georgette Anarkali flows into a full, dreamy flare finished with gold gota lace, while a hand-embroidered sweetheart neckline and scattered gold buttis add quiet sparkle. The matching georgette dupatta is edged in gota lace for a complete, regal look.

✦ The Details
• Sweetheart neckline with gold hand embroidery
• Hand-embroidered gold buttis on the bodice
• Fitted bodice with a full, flowy Anarkali flare
• Sheer full sleeves
• Gota lace finish on the hem
• Matching pants and georgette dupatta with gota lace border and buttis

✦ Fabric & Craft
Soft georgette with a lining – light, flowy and graceful, it moves beautifully when you walk and twirl. The neckline and buttis are hand-embroidered with gold thread and beads.

✦ Fit & Size
Regular fit. Choose your usual size or use our Fit Finder. Between sizes? Size up – or send us your bust, waist and hip and we will stitch it to your measurements.

✦ How to Style It
Gold or kundan jhumkas, a red bindi and pearl heels for a wedding or reception; a potli bag and loose curls for Diwali night. Add a statement ring and keep the neck bare to let the neckline shine.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen.
care: Dry clean only. Store folded with tissue to protect the gota lace and handwork.
